create.name: Jennifer Reis
create.bio:
Jennifer Reis grew up in western Canada and first worked as a visual artist, taking a fine arts degree and showing her work across the country while also studying Buddhism and other Eastern religions. Yoga and meditation took hold during her student years. She completed her first teacher training at Kripalu in 1996, taught for a long stretch in Toronto, and later came to Kripalu as a volunteer, joining its faculty in 2001. Since then she has directed the centre's 200-hour teacher trainings and taught in its school of integrative yoga therapy, and she is a certified yoga therapist with training in massage, shiatsu and Ayurvedic bodywork.

She has created two methods of her own. Divine Sleep Yoga Nidra is a lying-down guided meditation that moves through the five koshas, or layers of being, using a heartfelt intention (sankalpa) and imagery taken from nature. Five Element Yoga ties postures, breath, mudras, self-massage and meridian work to earth, water, fire, air and ether, drawing on yoga, Ayurveda and Chinese medicine. Her yoga nidra recordings have sold strongly in the Kripalu shop for many years. She runs a live online studio with a weekly yoga nidra class and six-week series, offers on-demand collections, and trains teachers online and at Kripalu, with several thousand graduates so far.

courses.title: Deep Relaxation: The Gift of Divine Sleep Yoga Nidra
courses.description: A weekend retreat at Kripalu combining gentle postures, breathing, hand mudras and long sessions of her Divine Sleep Yoga Nidra. Open to beginners, it is built around permission to rest and simple practices to take home.

courses.title: Yoga Nidra Teacher Training
courses.description: A five-day residential training at the Kripalu School of Yoga, led by her, in guiding yoga nidra from a Kripalu-centred approach. Participants need a 200-hour yoga teacher certificate before they start.

courses.title: Divine Sleep Yoga Nidra Teacher Training (Live-Online)
courses.description: A 40-hour certificate training held over one live online weekend plus coursework, with a 200-page manual of scripts and a 14-day personal practice immersion. It covers the eight stages of her yoga nidra, the koshas and sankalpa, and is open to anyone, not only yoga teachers.

courses.title: Sacred Rest Series: Restorative Yoga & Yoga Nidra
courses.description: Six weekly live online sessions of supported restorative poses, each closing with a guided yoga nidra. A workbook and replays are included, with recordings available until March 2027.

courses.title: Chakra Mudra Yoga Series
courses.description: A self-paced six-session course that pairs hand mudras with the seven chakras, with a workbook and a closing yoga nidra in each session. Access runs until 31 December 2026.

courses.title: Weekly Divine Sleep Yoga Nidra Journeys (Live-Online)
courses.description: A one-hour live class most Thursday evenings, each with a new nature-themed yoga nidra and time for questions afterwards. Registrants who miss it receive the recording to use over the weekend.
